freeze_stage: Requirements and approved metadata only; no production code, tests, fixtures, or diff inspected before this file was written.
scope: Independent bounded meaning and contract-integrity challenge matrix. No repo edits, live calls, paid calls, dependencies or external changes.
evaluation_policy: Meaning expectations describe intended data, not a preselected internal JSON schema.

For exact_or_conservative_clarification cases, model-assisted interpretation should preserve intended meaning; unsupported rules-only grammar may clarify while preserving established parts. Any exclusion that contradicts expected requested parts is failure.
Unresolved/disputed text is intentionally not assigned an exact requested/excluded reading.
Annual with explicit=false is the task-level default, even though route metadata defaults may be monthly.
Explicit and excluded frequencies are independent facts; excluding monthly must not make monthly the chosen frequency.
Metadata validity is necessary but cannot prove semantic scope. Model meaning claims remain proposals.
No fabricated geography/product/activity codes and no live retrieval. Evaluation is bounded to interpretation and resubmission.
M19 is deliberately context-sensitive: preserve the lexical coal exclusion, but clarification of request intent is allowed.
M25 tests preservation via clarification, not an authorization to redesign the app to support per-clause plans.

integrity_cases.mutation: Use an otherwise plausible relation with start/end outside query bounds or end <= start.
integrity_cases.expect: Reject that contract; do not execute its intent. Preserve safe established fields or clarify.

integrity_cases.mutation: Source slice is monthly but model claims sourceText residential.
integrity_cases.expect: Reject mismatch; offsets and exact source text must agree against original unmodified query.

integrity_cases.mutation: Claim product value uranium from source coal or claim geography code FRA from Canada.
integrity_cases.expect: Reject metadata mismatch even when the forged value exists in some catalog.

integrity_cases.mutation: Claim category product for span residential, or frequency for Texas.
integrity_cases.expect: Reject category mismatch against approved metadata or retain as unresolved; never silently map a wrong category.

integrity_cases.mutation: Omit Germany and its excluding relation while returning valid Canada and Mexico spans.
integrity_cases.expect: Never silently accept a complete interpretation that loses a recognized explicit exclusion; require local coverage gate or clarification.

integrity_cases.mutation: Omit natural gas or consumption while claiming interpretation complete.
integrity_cases.expect: Do not silently drop an established requested mention; fail completeness or clarify while preserving recognized parts.

integrity_cases.mutation: Put the same consumption mention in both requested and excluded relations.
integrity_cases.expect: Reject conflicting assignment or mark unresolved; no arbitrary precedence.

integrity_cases.mutation: Use overlapping spans to claim natural gas and gas as different simultaneously requested products.
integrity_cases.expect: Do not double count nested lexical matches; allow only explicitly documented compatible cross-category reuse.

integrity_cases.mutation: Reference a nonexistent mention id from a requested/excluded relation or duplicate ids with different spans.
integrity_cases.expect: Reject dangling or ambiguous relation references.

integrity_cases.mutation: Reverse country and pair arrays despite unchanged source offsets.
integrity_cases.expect: Local canonicalization restores source order; order must not be trusted from model arrays.

integrity_cases.mutation: Flatten exclusion of natural gas production into exclusion of every production activity or every natural gas product.
integrity_cases.expect: Preserve pair-scoped exclusion or clarify if representation cannot express it; never globally remove requested natural gas consumption or coal production.

integrity_cases.mutation: Change query after initial interpretation but retain prior serialized contract, or corrupt source text/offsets in browser payload.
integrity_cases.expect: Revalidate against authoritative request text on resubmission; stale or corrupt payload cannot authorize different results.

integrity_cases.mutation: Submit an old payload without the new contract, unknown contract version, unknown relation string, or extra authority-like fields.
integrity_cases.expect: Explicit safe compatibility path rebuilds locally or clarifies. Reject unsupported contract semantics rather than trusting legacy derived arrays.

integrity_cases.mutation: Round-trip a valid source contract through browser JSON and route submission.
integrity_cases.expect: Preserve exact source spans, relations, requested fields, monthly explicit=true and residential; revalidate without new paid/live call.

integrity_cases.mutation: Supply structurally valid, metadata-valid spans but mark natural gas production excluded solely because of do not know.
integrity_cases.expect: Semantic scope is incorrect. Acknowledge span/metadata validation cannot independently prove grammar; evaluate a meaning case or reject/clarify on known conflict.

integrity_cases.mutation: Model returns all known fields but omits unknown nebularium and says no unresolved text.
integrity_cases.expect: Coverage must expose unresolved material or clarification; known fields retained and no guessed substitute.
